mapper.sql: CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id,CAST(customer_id AS CHAR) AS owner,CAST(warehouse_id AS CHAR) AS warehouseId, state,CAST(coupon_id AS CHAR) AS couponId,expires_at AS expiresAt,cancelled_at AS cancelledAt,version
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sales_order WHERE customer_id = CAST(#{owner} AS UNSIGNED) AND id = CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED) FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM sales_order WHERE id = CAST(#{id} AS UNSIGNED) FOR UPDATE

SELECT CAST(id AS CHAR) AS id,CAST(order_id AS CHAR) AS orderId,CAST(sku_id AS CHAR) AS skuId,quantity,line_no AS lineNo FROM sales_order_item WHERE order_id = CAST(#{orderId} AS UNSIGNED) ORDER BY line_no,id LIMIT 101
